title: arabis viridis var. typica
intro: Arabis viridis var. typica, commonly known as Wild Rock Cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties, as well as its ability to soothe digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Arabis viridis var. typica include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
